worldcombat.skill.sing.summary: Sings a soothing lullaby whose sound rings travel out through walls and allies into every nearby foe; a listener that hears enough lines falls asleep on the spot. The singer stands still while singing, and taking a hit or being interrupted leaves only half a melody — anyone who steps out of earshot slowly comes round.
worldcombat.skill.sing.use.0: Put a pack of closing melee attackers to sleep together
worldcombat.skill.sing.use.1: Drop a ring of nearby threats before the fight starts
worldcombat.skill.sing.use.2: Create several sleep targets for an ally's Dream Eater or Nightmare
worldcombat.skill.sing.description.0: The sound rings spread from the singer and cover a radius of %1$s; sound ignores cover — walls and allies cannot block it, only distance counts. One line every %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.sing.description.1: Foes still awake in the field must hear %1$s lines before they fall asleep, for %2$s; a hit wakes them at once.
worldcombat.skill.sing.description.2: Each line leaves drowsiness for %1$s; once out of earshot it fades in that time and the count starts over. Every line also sends out %2$s sound rings.
worldcombat.skill.sing.soothing.on: Long lullaby: sleep ×1.25, one more line needed and cooldown ×1.1, at the cost of field ×0.85.
worldcombat.skill.sing.soothing.off: Bright lullaby: field ×1.15, one fewer line needed and cooldown ×0.9, at the cost of sleep ×0.8.
worldcombat.skill.sing.growth.0: From level %1$s each line sends out %2$s sound rings.
worldcombat.skill.sing.growth.1: From level %1$s the rings are %2$s, the sleep %3$s and the needed lines drop to %4$s.
worldcombat.skill.sing.preference.soothi: On: sleep ×1.25, one more line needed and cooldown ×1.1, but field ×0.85 — for singing one tough target fully to sleep. Off (bright): field ×1.15, one fewer line needed and cooldown ×0.9, but sleep ×0.8 — for covering more foes faster.
worldcombat.skill.sing.preference.ai.min: Only start singing when at least this many foes are still awake inside the field; 1 means sing whenever anyone awake is nearby, higher waits for a crowd.
worldcombat.skill.sing.preference.ai.lea: When on, the partner will also leave its post to sing; when off it only sings where it already reaches.
